title: No Save Zone
body:
# No Save Zone

No Save Zone is a hardcore zombie apocalypse modpack focused on survival against constantly evolving undead threats.

In this world, zombies are far more dangerous than in vanilla Minecraft. They can break blocks, gain powerful effects, adapt to their environment, and use abilities that make traditional defenses unreliable.

## Features

* Intelligent and evolving zombies
* Zombies capable of breaking blocks
* Special infected with unique abilities
* Increased survival difficulty
* Scarce resources and dangerous exploration
* Challenging combat and progression
* Post-apocalyptic atmosphere

## Survival Is Not Guaranteed

Building a shelter is only the beginning. Every night brings new dangers, and even the strongest base can be breached by the growing undead threat.

Gather resources, improve your equipment, fortify your defenses, and see how long you can survive in a world where nowhere is truly safe.

### Can you survive the No Save Zone?
